summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Central North Airport Group (OMA) reporting its first quarter 2026 operating and financial results. It discloses passenger traffic growth, revenue increases, and operational metrics such as commercial occupancy and hotel performance. The filing is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is referenced. The document serves as an update to shareholders under SEC Rule 13a-16.
